name: direction-aware-tabs
title: Direction Aware Tabs
description: A dark pill-shaped bar holds three tabs, with a lighter cap that springs to whichever is chosen. The panel beneath swaps its heading and copy with a sideways slide and a soft blur.
use: A compact section needs to switch between two to four short pieces of content.
avoid: Content must be defined in code as React nodes, and the rail only holds a few short labels.
a11y: Focus styles exist, but there are no tablist roles, no aria-selected and no arrow-key handling. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded panel holds a pill-shaped tab bar with three labels: Design, Develop and Deploy. The chosen tab wears a lighter rounded cap, and a centred heading with two lines of grey copy sits below.
behaves: Clicking a tab sends the lighter pill sliding to it and swaps the panel text, which flies in from the side and blurs into focus. The panel height settles to fit the new copy.
customise: Tabs come as an array of id, label and content; outer and inner radius plus a change callback are props. Colours are fixed to neutral greys.
weight: light: Three buttons and one animated content panel; no canvas or endless loop.
